items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: But my grandson Doug Kassel plays drums quite good, quite well.

ctx.x: No, she could sing a little bit, she sang pretty good, but she wasn't interested in show business or anything like that. She wanted to get married and settle down. But my grandson Doug Kassel plays drums quite good, quite well. Plays pretty good.
Are you reasonably close to the grandchildren?
